what.en: Arm, disarm and check the car from your phone. Every alarm event arrives as a push notification, SMS or email, with an event history and recorded routes.

how.en: Nearby over Bluetooth 5.0 (about 50 m). Systems with a modem also work from anywhere through the free pandora-on.com web service, and the built-in Self Call-Center rings your phone on a breach with no third-party monitoring centre.

needs.en: Light Pro V2 and Primo work over Bluetooth only (no modem). Immo uses the Pandect BT app. Light V3 has no app.

what.en: A satellite receiver (GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou) reports the vehicle's position and movement on the map in the app and web service. Elite V3 adds Wi-Fi positioning for garages and underground car parks where satellites fail.

how.en: Position is logged with every event. Black Box keeps the record inside the unit and syncs it when signal returns.

needs.en: Smart V4 uses the external NAV-035 BT receiver in the box. Optional on Light Pro V2 and Primo with the NAV-X unit.

what.en: A built-in 4G/3G/2G modem keeps the system connected to Pandora's servers, so alerts, location and remote commands work from anywhere, not just within remote range.

how.en: Telemetry covers battery voltage, temperatures, EV battery level and trip routes. With Active Protection the server watches the link and notifies you if it is cut.

needs.en: A SIM with a data plan.

what.en: BT-790 tags are small encrypted Bluetooth 5.0 transmitters you carry. With a tag near, the system disarms hands-free and lets the engine start. Without it: NO TAG, NO DRIVE.

how.en: Two tags included on most systems, up to four supported. The tag also drives Prohibit disarming.

what.en: Blocks the engine unless the driver is recognised, by tag, by a PIN entered on the car's own buttons, or both. A copied key alone does not start the car.

how.en: Works on the CAN-bus together with the IMO 10 blocking relay. PIN entry uses factory buttons, so no extra switch is visible.

what.en: If the car is taken by force, the system lets the thief drive for about a minute and then blocks the engine. The driver is already at a safe distance and the car cannot be restarted.

how.en: Triggered when the owner's tag leaves the running car.

what.en: Start the engine from the remote or app, or automatically by time, voltage or temperature, to warm or cool the cabin before you get in.

how.en: Turbo timer and Ignition ON keep turbo engines running correctly with the alarm armed. An immobilizer-bypass algorithm avoids hiding a factory key in the cabin on most cars.

needs.en: The optional RMD-5M relay module on the car and camper systems; vehicle support varies.

what.en: A digital three-axis sensor with two shock zones plus tilt and lift detection. It tells a knock on the door from a jack under the car or a wheel being removed.

how.en: Sensitivity is adjusted per zone from the app or remote; algorithms filter false alarms.

what.en: A piezoelectric siren. PS-330 is wired; PS-331 BT and PS-332 BT connect over Bluetooth, so they need no wiring in the engine bay and can be hidden anywhere.

how.en: The Bluetooth sirens are Jammer Ready: if contact with the unit is cut, the siren sounds on its own. PS-332 BT adds a backup battery. Output above 120 dB.

needs.en: Every system except Immo ships with one; the model is listed per system.

what.en: Even if thieves clone the key or relay its signal with a roll-jammer, the alarm stays armed and the engine stays locked unless the ID-tag is present.

how.en: Uses the BT-790 tag's presence as the second factor.

what.en: With Active Protection the system stays connected to Pandora's servers. If a jammer blocks GSM or GPS, the server notices the gap and notifies you by push, email and app history.

how.en: Bluetooth sirens and blockers react to lost contact on their own, so jamming the signal triggers the alarm instead of silencing it.

what.en: All location and event data is written to the central unit. If the mobile signal drops, nothing is lost: the record syncs to the cloud once the connection returns.

how.en: Useful in car parks, low-coverage areas and during SIM problems.

what.en: The OLED remote controls the alarm and receives alerts up to 1000 m away, readable in direct sunlight, with telemetry such as battery voltage, temperatures, fuel level and signal.

how.en: Elite V3 and Professional V3 ship the Commander remote: vertical OLED, LoRa long range, Bluetooth 5.0, wireless charging and an SOS button.

what.en: Remote and unit talk over multi-channel 868 MHz with automatic channel hopping and AES-128 encryption, so codes cannot be captured and replayed.
Connects to the car's own networks to arm from the factory key, close windows, lock doors and read vehicle status. Analog inputs cover older cars without CAN.

how.en: Dual high-speed CAN up to 1 Mbit/s plus LIN. Smart Pro V4 FD runs four CAN links, two of them CAN FD, for the newest EV, PHEV and hybrid platforms.

what.en: Pandora systems are certified to CE, E-mark, IATF 16949:2016 and Thatcham standards.
Lifetime warranty with immediate replacement of the central unit, free annual software upgrades, and transfer to another car by software update.

how.en: Activate it online after installation.

what.en: Small enough to hide in hard-to-reach places (Primo: 45 × 25 × 8 mm). Safe for the car's electronics and creates no diagnostic interference.
Over 20 Bluetooth accessories: hidden engine blockers, OBD blocks, door blockers, motion sensors and GPS/GSM controllers, installed without wires and with encrypted links.

how.en: Placed anywhere in the car, as hidden as possible.

what.en: Manual driver recognition: the engine starts only after the PIN is entered.

how.en: The code is keyed on the car's own buttons, so no extra switch is visible.

what.en: Automatic driver recognition through your smartphone: the phone works as the authorisation tag.
Locates the vehicle by nearby Wi-Fi networks, for underground and covered spaces where satellite positioning fails.
Locates the vehicle through the GSM mobile network instead of satellites.
Alerts reach your phone even when the Pandora Connect app is closed.
On an alarm the system itself calls your phone, with no third-party monitoring centre.

how.en: Includes the free online server pandora-on.com.

what.en: Arm and disarm the system with the car's own factory key.
The remote control supplied with the system; the model is listed per system.

how.en: Two-way models with an OLED display (D-061, D-062, D-022, D-010) receive alerts and show the system's status. R-series remotes also work as the owner's authorisation tag.

what.en: Remote or automatic engine start on keyless cars, without leaving a factory key hidden in the cabin.

how.en: An immobilizer-bypass algorithm stands in for the key.

needs.en: Where a key is still needed, the DI-02, DI-03 or DI-04 bypass modules handle it.

what.en: Controls a Webasto or Eberspächer fuel preheater, or an analog heater, from the system.
